correctness.rationale: Direct allocation to t distinguished bins gives exact E(Y_{j,m})_t=(m)_t (n)_{jt}/((j!)^t m^{jt})(1-t/m)^{n-jt}. At j=r it tends to (e^-c/r!)^t; source maps are independent across colors. For j<r, expectation vanishes, while j>r, mean diverges and the second factorial moment ratio tends to one. Pairwise low-fiber intersections across colors have expectation O((log m)^{2M}/m) and vanish, allowing deterministic finite-rank bin types. In the q-round Ehrenfeucht–Fraïssé game, match bins already chosen or images of source elements, preserve exact small sizes and use >=q+1 available elements otherwise; rare bin categories match by truncated counts and all nonrare categories are abundant. Every finite threshold event is FO definable. Independently enumerated m=3,n=5,r=1 factorial moments at orders 1,2,3, agreeing exactly.
residual_risks: Computations are bounded corroboration; arbitrary-domain correctness follows from the mathematical block, wedge, orbit or EF proof, not finite tests.
